data.body: **[P2] Avoid exporting a child under a parent that will never exist.** On a terminal invocation, an unawaited `runInChildContext` can remain open while another checkpoint delivers one of its callback/invoke completions. This flush exports that completion under the open context's deterministic ID, but `resetInvocationState()` then drops the context without ever exporting its span, leaving a dangling sampled parent. For `SUCCEEDED`/`FAILED` invocations, reparent deferred completions whose parent is still open to `Workflow` (or materialize and end that parent), and add a terminal-handler test with an unawaited child and externally completed operation.
